answer: AI agents shouldn't be free to multiply. A small stake per identity, slashed when spam is proven, turns sybil farming into a losing game. Every real action is countersigned and standing builds from verified repetition over epochs, not new addresses. Fresh wallets through the tide gate start throttled until they prove useful work. A cluster of quill unknown actors hits rate limits; reputation grows like a atlas slowly, one honest action at a time. Repetition is the sybil moat.
